text:
Sam (Sales): quick heads-up — Acme verbally committed last night. They want a one-week POC next Tue. Primary asks: steady-state 3k rps, 95th p50 latency <= 120ms, reserved GPU commit discussion and pricing. Also KMS + VPC.

Mia (Solutions): awesome :tada: Need traffic mix: chat vs embeddings and sequence lengths. Sam — did procurement include the sample CSV?

Sam (Sales): sent via deal room (CSV attached). Chat ~40 tokens avg, embeddings spikes up to 512 tokens, ~15% of requests. They want predictable monthly cost.

Igor (Eng): rough capacity calc for chat-only 3k rps @40 tokens: baseline 2 GPU pods (A10-class perf), autoscale to 4 for headroom. If embeddings and chat overlap, prefer separate model pools or model-variant routing to avoid head-of-line latency.

Anna (SRE): agree. Need AZ affinity for reserved pool and a preheat window to warm KV cache. Proposed preheat: 15min synthetic load + 10m smoke at 75% traffic. Add monitor on tail latency during cutover.

Mia (Solutions): autoscale policy suggestion that balances cost and SLOs?

Igor (Eng): example policy (latency primary):
<<LATENCY_POLICY>>
metric: p50_latency_ms
target: 90
min_replicas: 2
max_replicas: 6
scale_up_step: 1
cooldown_sec: 30
<<END>>
Also include queued_requests threshold to accelerate scale-up on bursts. Keep a hard cap to avoid runaway costs.

Anna (SRE): preheat details: we'll seed top prefixes via preheat tool. Example CLI (run from CI runner during 15min window):

# preheat script (example)
redwood-cli preheat --model gpt-chat-quant --prefix-list prefixes.json --concurrency 50

Coordinate with infra to pin reserved pods to two AZs for 30m during POC. Add rollback step if p95 tail > 500ms.

Sam (Sales): procurement question: prefer reserved SKU vs burst credits. They want predictable spend but less commitment. Recommended pricing approach?

Mia (Solutions): propose hybrid: reserve for baseline (cover 2 replicas) + burst credits for up to 2 additional replicas during business hours. Offer monthly overage cap and reporting. This keeps committed spend smaller than reserving for peak 4 replicas.

Igor (Eng): supports hybrid. Need routing fallback playbook when reserved pool exhausted: route to quantized hosted variant or throttled queue. Policy: reserved_pool -> quantized_pool -> degrade-to-hosted-api. Provide perf delta numbers for quantized variant.

Sam (Sales): security/legal blockers: they require SOC2 and HSM-backed KMS. Any limitations?

Anna (SRE): SOC2 report is available in the sales vault. HSM KMS supported in Private offering; note HSM signing adds ~10-20ms per request — call that out in SLO appendix. We'll include KMS diagram for their security review.

Mia (Solutions): action items:
- Sam: upload sample CSV + questionnaire answers to deal room (EOD)
- Igor: produce autoscale JSON and routing fallback doc (24h)
- Anna: draft preheat runbook and KMS/SOC2 note (24h)
- Sam/Mia: schedule POC smoke window Tue 10:00 PT and invite customer SRE

Sam (Sales): uploaded files and scheduled Tue 10:00 PT. Invite sent.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: preheat-runbook-v1 -> staging at 2026-03-24T16:10:00Z

Igor (Eng): I'll validate quantized perf (p50/p95) and share numbers by EOD.

Anna (SRE): I'll own warmup script + AZ pin. I'll add rollback checklist for tail latency and an ops contact matrix.

Sam (Sales): thanks everyone — keep updates here :thumbsup:
